messages:
Alex G: ap-south edge proxies started failing TLS verify after cert-rotator canary rolled ~14:02 UTC.
Maria P: paste error lines?
Alex G: 
2026-03-21T14:02:18Z proxy[edge-1]: TLS verify error: x509:certificate signed by unknown authority (certificate verification loop detected)
2026-03-21T14:02:19Z proxy[edge-2]: TLS handshake failed: chain validation resulted in a cycle
Cheng L: likely duplicate intermediate/root in chain. can you dump the secret?
Alex G: secret tls.crt decodes to: leaf -> intermediate A -> intermediate A -> root CA (duplicate intermediate).
Jonah S: rotator logs show it concatenated intermediate.pem twice during the canary. KMS unwraps are normal.
rotator-bot: canary rollout completed for cert-rotator v2 (3 pods) — 14:01 UTC ✅
Maria P: any recent RBAC/SA changes?
Alex G: cert-rotator SA had secretmanager.versions.access widened 48h ago (PR #872). noted.
Cheng L: mitigation: rollback canary, normalize chain and reload secret, restart proxies.
Jonah S: pushed a small normalizer and tested in staging; opened PR #891 for dedupe + verify gate.
Alex G: rolling back now: `kubectl -n infra rollout undo deployment/cert-rotator --to-revision=18`
deploy-bot: rollback started for cert-rotator to revision 18 — triggered by @Alex G at 14:12 UTC
Maria P: grabbing KMS audit and Secret Manager logs for 13:58–14:05. no denies so far.
Jonah S: after applying normalized chain to one edge pod errors dropped to ~0.8% in 5m.
Cheng L: follow-ups: add chain-normalization in rotator, add unit/e2e tests, run `openssl verify` as assembly gate, add SM write alerts for chain-length deltas, update RBAC playbook for cert pushes.
Alex G: creating incident postmortem stub and owners: Jonah -> hotfix/tests; Maria -> audit/RBAC; Cheng -> rollout gating; I’ll write PM. closing when postmortem linked. :thumbsup:
